name: Methoxypiperamide
summary: Drug of the Piperazine class. The 4-Methoxy-α-keto analogue of Methylbenzylpiperazine. The drug is reported to inactive on its own. The drug was sold in combination with Mephtetramine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Methoxypiperamide (also known as MeOP and MEXP) is a psychoactive drug of the piperazine class that has been sold online as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 甲氧基哌拉醯胺是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C13H18N2O2，屬於匹配拉淨衍生物，與1-甲基-4-苯甲基匹配拉淨結構上類似，可作為精神藥物。

fact.en: It was sold online together with mephtetramine. A carbonyl group links its piperazine ring to a methoxybenzene ring, which makes it an amide rather than a simple amine like BZP.
fact.zh: 它曾與 mephtetramine 一起在網路上販售。它以一個羰基把哌嗪環與甲氧基苯環連在一起，因此屬於醯胺，而不是像 BZP 那樣的單純胺類。
fact.zhHans: 它曾与 mephtetramine 一起在网络上贩售。它以一个羰基把哌嗪环与甲氧基苯环连在一起，因此属于酰胺，而不是像 BZP 那样的单纯胺类。
